mapper.select: SELECT x, y, zoom FROM graph_viewport WHERE owner_id = #{owner}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO graph_viewport (owner_id, x, y, zoom) VALUES (#{owner}, #{viewport.x}, #{viewport.y}, #{viewport.zoom}) AS incoming ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE x = incoming.x, y = incoming.y, zoom = incoming.zoom
mapper.select: SELECT i.id, v.title, p.x, p.y FROM knowledge_item i JOIN knowledge_version v ON v.id = i.current_version_id AND v.item_id = i.id AND v.owner_id = i.owner_id JOIN knowledge_position p ON p.item_id = i.id AND p.owner_id = i.owner_id WHERE i.owner_id = #{owner} AND i.kind = 'CONCEPT' AND i.status = 'ACTIVE' AND i.id IN #{id} ORDER BY i.id

SELECT r.id, r.source_id, r.target_id, r.relation_type FROM knowledge_relation r JOIN knowledge_item s ON s.id = r.source_id AND s.owner_id = r.owner_id JOIN knowledge_item t ON t.id = r.target_id AND t.owner_id = r.owner_id WHERE r.owner_id = #{owner} AND s.kind = 'CONCEPT' AND t.kind = 'CONCEPT' AND s.status = 'ACTIVE' AND t.status = 'ACTIVE' AND r.relation_type = #{type} ORDER BY r.id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO graph_layout_history (owner_id, revision, before_json, after_json, position_count, created_at) VALUES (#{owner}, #{revision}, #{beforeJson}, #{afterJson}, #{positionCount}, #{now})
mapper.select: SELECT revision, before_json, after_json FROM graph_layout_history WHERE owner_id = #{owner} AND revision = #{revision}
